claims.claim_text: Plasma %p-tau217 was clinically equivalent to FDA-approved CSF tests in classifying Aβ PET status, with AUC between 0.95 and 0.97.
Plasma %p-tau217 was generally superior to CSF tests in classification of tau-PET with AUCs of 0.95-0.98.
plasma %p-tau217 had an accuracy, a positive predictive value and a negative predictive value of 89-90% for Aβ PET
accuracy, a positive predictive value and a negative predictive value of 87-88% for tau PET status
a 33.3% reduction in the median number of therapeutic plasma exchange days (5.0 vs 7.5 days) vs placebo.
further improving to 95% using a two-cutoffs approach.
Patients who fail medical therapy should be treated with therapeutic plasma exchange or thyroidectomy.
